calibration.scope: Empirical held-out error for this sampler change only; not a confidence bound for different physics or reconstruction.

decomposition.scope: All five requested terms with explicit first-order/source-partition assumptions. Exact bookkeeping includes a named unresolved higher-order/reference/primary-cloudlight remainder, not an independent measurement of each physical path family.

contracts.new_optical_depth: two-node Gauss per trilinear interpolation interval; exact for its cubic ray polynomial
contracts.new_terrain_intersection: quadratic bilinear-cell roots, bounded only by the terrain AABB and cell boundaries

visibility_valid_air_factorial.estimator: 192 directions, exact trilinear optical depth and bilinear terrain roots in every cell
visibility_valid_air_factorial.tent: same production tent with density support in every cell

contract.geometry: bilinear terrain leaf roots, reference query tmin 1e-3

nested_difference.scope: Observed coarse/fine numerical difference, not an infinite-resolution error bound or full transport proof

source_domain_policy.reference_first_order: untruncated medium on either side of the open bilinear surface; same domain for both lighting ablations
source_domain_policy.higher_orders: archived closures retain historical domain rules; hybrids do not certify full reference-domain physics
source_domain_policy.production_decision: NOT_MADE: terrain_occlusion_in_media=False must control any new visibility term; domain changes require explicit transport justification before implementation

limitations: No full-angular higher-order solution or quantified error for changing that closure
Archived candidates retain their historical, unqualified numerical parameters; fresh first-order terms use named contracts and the recorded nested comparison
Geometry uses the reference bilinear surface, not runtime CSM; no CSM buffer was captured
Held-out sensitivity cannot certify unrelated changes
HEAD is uncaptured; source inspection cannot prove GPU equivalence
